Name: Community Center Revitalized
Author: Retrojones81
Description:
[size=4][b]Community Center Revitalized[/b][/size]

After you restore the Community Center, every room gets a [b]station[/b] you can use. Each station sits where that room's Junimo bundle note used to hang. Walk up to it and press the action button.

[b]Rooms[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Vault:[/b] deposit and withdraw gold, set savings goals, and donate to the Community Fund. Money here is safe if you pass out.[/*]
[*][b]Crafts Room:[/b] a working loom for cloth, twine, quilt squares and seasonal banners. Every 12 quilt squares finishes a named town quilt for the Quilt Wall.[/*]
[*][b]Pantry:[/b] donate food to raise villagers' friendship, and cook in the community kitchen.[/*]
[*][b]Fish Tank:[/b] donate one of each fish species and watch them swim in the real aquarium. Willy gives milestone rewards.[/*]
[*][b]Boiler Room:[/b] smelt 5 bars a day for free, plus extra smelts powered by donated coal.[/*]
[*][b]Bulletin Board:[/b] one multi-part community request per week, with gold, friendship and item rewards.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Community Fund[/b]
8 categories (Food Pantry, Education, Town Repairs, Festival Fund, Clinic Support, Arts & Crafts, Fishing Club, Emergency Fund), each with 3 projects. Finished projects unlock perks like weekly community dinners, Penny's classes, care packages from Harvey, Fishing Club meetings, interest on savings, and more.

[b]Room decorations[/b]
The Community Center visibly changes as you support it: benches, lamps, bookcases, banners, rugs, plants, your finished quilts on the wall, and your donated fish in the aquarium.

[b]Gatherings[/b]
Villagers come to the Community Center in person for weekly events: Penny's class, a stretch class, a craft circle, board game night, Friday community dinner, Fishing Club, the Sunday town meeting, and a rainy-day reading hour. Visit during a gathering for friendship with every host.

[b]Controls[/b]
[list]
[*][b]F8[/b] opens the Community Ledger, a summary of your progress.[/*]
[*]All settings can be changed with Generic Mod Config Menu or in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change settings in-game.[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Uninstall[/b]
Before removing the mod, type [font=Courier New]ccr_decor remove[/font] in the SMAPI console to take out the decorations. Otherwise the furniture stays in the Community Center and can be picked up.

[b]Limitations[/b]
[list]
[*]Single-player / host only: progress is stored in the host's save, and farmhands can't use the stations yet.[/*]
[*]Inactive on the Joja route.[/*]
[*]English only.[/*]
[*]A mod that heavily rearranges the restored Community Center map could put the stations in odd spots.[/*]
[/list]
